description: The agent must: (1) Read and synthesize data from at least 4 scattered files: webb_offer_intake_DRAFT.txt (primary source), finance_approval_email.txt (equity legal note), 2025_benefits_summary.txt, at_will_employment_policy.txt, and org_chart for manager context. (2) Follow the SKILL.md output structure exactly: company letterhead (NovaBio header + address), date, candidate name, 'Dear Marcus,' salutation, 'RE: Employment Offer - Director of Clinical Operations' subject line, POSITION DETAILS section, COMPENSATION section (with $205,000 base, bi-weekly pay, $15,000 signing bonus, 20% annual bonus target, 18,000 options with 4-year vest and 1-year cliff, AND a reference to the full Option Agreement per finance email + SKILL.md legal guidance), BENEFITS section, CONTINGENCIES section (background check + I-9/work eligibility), response deadline June 2 2025, closing signed by Dr. Priya Nair / SVP Clinical Development. (3) The CRITICAL proprietary trap: the ACCEPTANCE block at the bottom MUST include the '---' separator, the word ACCEPTANCE, and the three exact signature lines from the SKILL.md template: 'Signature: _______________________', 'Print Name: ______________________', 'Date: ___________________________'. (4) At-will employment statement must be included. An agent relying on generic training will produce a letter but will miss: the exact acceptance block format, the cliff specification in equity, the option agreement reference, and the at-will clause.
